reason: The mapping to Article 3 is too broad and does not provide a specific regulatory basis for the control objective of reviewing the policy on the use of ICT third-party services at least once a year. Article 3 is a general provision on definitions and scope, and it does not contain the specific requirement for an annual review.
missing_mapping: [{"instrument": "Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1773", "provision": "Article 28", "reason": "Article 28 contains the specific requirement for financial entities to review their ICT third-party risk management arrangements at least annually, which directly supports the control objective.", "evidence_ids": []}]
applicability_note: The control is applicable to financial entities under DORA, which are required to manage risks associated with ICT third-party service providers.
challenge_comment: The existing mapping to a general article (Article 3) is insufficient to justify the specific control requirement. A more precise citation to the relevant operational provision is necessary for a defensible basis.
